promptText: Use case: stylized-concept. Create one original native 1254 x 1254 terrain patch precisely continuing the approved hand-painted fantasy game map. Image 4 is the approved full map for art direction only, not objects to copy into this patch. Entire patch is uninterrupted clear bright turquoise ocean, no rocks, no sand, no dry land or objects. Very subtle pale underwater light near upper-right and near bottom-center as in image 1, no circular islands or dense foam rings. Keep rounded calm painterly water facets and small delicate surface highlights, no directional breaking wave. Refined rounded Q Daoist hand-painted game art, diffuse bright daylight, same elevated camera and object scale, restrained mineral detail and painterly surface depth. Keep the exact existing coast; no added rocks, architecture, vegetation, props, characters, text, interface, borders or grid markings. Native original detail, not an enlarged overview. Output the complete square terrain patch, no reference montage.
